homeServices.description: We support clinics, hospitals and healthcare professionals with their projects and technical needs.

rooms.title: Medical room adaptation
rooms.description: Construction and adaptation of medical spaces to meet the needs of each facility.
rooms.detail: We plan and adapt medical rooms with healthcare professionals and facility managers. From building work to the final use of the space, we consider clinical needs, the requirements of each facility and applicable regulations.

quality.title: Quality control
quality.description: Evaluation of diagnostic imaging equipment to check its operating parameters.
quality.detail: We carry out quality checks on diagnostic imaging equipment to review its operating parameters. These checks help identify deviations and support suitable conditions for medical examinations.

radiation.title: Radiation protection
radiation.description: Shielding calculations and radiation measurements for clinical and hospital facilities.
radiation.detail: We perform shielding calculations and radiation measurements for clinics and hospitals. This work helps assess each facility's protection measures and guide any changes needed to protect patients and staff.

equipment.title: Medical equipment
equipment.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance to support the operation of medical equipment.
equipment.detail: We provide preventive and corrective maintenance for medical equipment, with attention to how safely and reliably it operates. We assess each device's needs and plan work that supports the continuity of clinical care.
